owner_authority_note: Current 2026-08-17 ClayVerse single-container owner directive supersedes legacy EntityOS-as-single-file endpoint cache.
frontier: Browser WebSocket PTY attach lifecycle / transient child reaping

bug.mechanism: TerminalSessionManager.close_attach closed the PTY fd and sent SIGHUP but did not waitpid the transient attach child.
bug.product_risk: Repeated browser disconnect/reconnect cycles can leave waitable zombie attach children in the long-lived ClayVerse container.

repair.behavior: After SIGHUP, bounded nonblocking waitpid reaps the child; after 0.5 s the cleanup escalates to SIGKILL and blocking waitpid. terminal_gateway keeps cleanup off the asyncio event loop via asyncio.to_thread.

unusual_experiment.name: SIGHUP-resistant transient attach child
unusual_experiment.purpose: Falsify the assumption that SIGHUP alone guarantees bounded attach cleanup.
unusual_experiment.replications: Subsequent synchronized and Vercel repetitions are regression-only repetitions of the same intervention and add zero unusual experiments.

vercel_sandbox.duplicate_build_invocation_note: Vercel invoked the build script twice; both outputs were identical PASS results and count only as ordinary replication.
vercel_sandbox.scope_limit: This execution proves the e1ff1235/96561f blob behavior. Later main commits preserve the same close_attach logic by source inspection, but no second exact-current-total-blob Vercel execution was observed because the low-level test-branch ref update did not trigger a new Git deployment.

parallel_state.note: Main advanced concurrently with independent Clay workers. The repaired close_attach logic was rechecked at observed head bc372def and remained present in terminal_sessions blob 3fe4b74e.

evidence_note: Component/source/Sandbox PASS for terminal attach cleanup does not imply whole ClayVerse container PASS.
